name: Swatchify – Product Variation Maker for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Swatchify is the ultimate solution for WooCommerce store owners who want to upgrade both their customer’s shopping experience and their own store management workflow. It replaces the clunky default WooCommerce variation dropdowns with beautiful, clickable swatches on the frontend, and completely overhauls the backend variation creation process with a lightning-fast React application.

Creating variable products in WooCommerce is notoriously tedious. Swatchify solves this.

With the Swatchify Variation Maker, store admins can visually build complex products, manage attributes, and set pricing and stock in seconds using an intuitive, matrix-style interface—saving massive amounts of time and eliminating administrative friction.

🔥 Key Features

For Your Customers (Frontend)
* Beautiful Variation Swatches: Automatically converts standard WooCommerce dropdowns into sleek, clickable text and image swatches.
* Fully Customizable Design: Choose between Square, Rounded, or Circle swatches, and adjust sizes (Small, Medium, Large) to perfectly match your theme.
* Smart Stock Display: Automatically manages stock visibility on the frontend. If a product is unlimited, the stock badge remains hidden to keep the UI clean.
* Enhanced Shopping Experience: Visually clear options reduce friction, helping to increase conversion rates and sales.

For Store Owners (Backend)
* Lightning-Fast Variation Maker: A modern, React-powered single-page application (SPA) integrated directly into the WooCommerce product edit screen.
* Visual Option Building: Add and manage attributes (like Size, Color, Material) in a beautifully structured card-based UI.
* Pricing & Combinations Matrix: Easily assign regular prices, sale prices, stock quantities, and SKUs across all generated combinations in one centralized matrix.
* Global Variation Categories: Create and manage global product attributes seamlessly from a dedicated, fast interface.
* Minimalist & Lightweight: Built with performance in mind. No bloat, no heavy queries—just a smooth, snappy experience.

Why You Need Swatchify

  • Save Time: Building out 50+ variations for a t-shirt (sizes x colors) takes minutes with WooCommerce’s default tools. With Swatchify’s Variation Maker, it takes seconds.
  • Boost Sales: Customers abandon carts when product pages are confusing. Clean swatches make purchasing decisions instantaneous.
  • Modernize Your Backend: Stop fighting with slow, refreshing WordPress admin pages. Experience a desktop-software-like experience right inside your browser.

How to Use

Managing Swatches on the Frontend
Using Swatchify is completely automatic. It applies to your existing WooCommerce variable products out of the box.
1. Navigate to Swatchify -> Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
2. Choose your preferred swatch shape (Square, Rounded, or Circle) and size.
3. Your frontend products will instantly reflect the beautiful new design.

Using the Variation Maker
1. Edit any Variable Product in WooCommerce.
2. You will see a prominent “Manage Variations via Swatchify” button inside the Product Data box.
3. Click it to launch the modern Variation Maker interface.
4. Add attributes, set your options, and fill out the pricing/stock combinations.
5. Click Save—everything is synced instantly back to WooCommerce!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swatchify-variation-swatches directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes! Swatchify is designed to hook into standard WooCommerce templates, meaning it is compatible with 99% of WooCommerce-ready themes out of the box.

Do I need to learn a new system to use the Variation Maker?

Not at all. The interface is highly intuitive and visually guides you through adding attributes, selecting options, and setting prices in a simple matrix.

  • Initial release featuring the React-powered Variation Maker, Settings panel, and Frontend Swatch rendering engine.
